notes.title: Update: v0.5.0
notes.content:
Hello,

With this update, more resource types and mechanics are added. You have more control over the late game. And, overall game difficulty is easier now.

The most notable changes are:
[list]
[*] Mining feature; Removed "Material Industry" and added "Mine" instead. Now there are new types of building material resources; "Stone", "Coal" and "Cement". Mines extract natural resources that can be seen using the "Biome and Natural Resources" view mode. Natural resources are limited, when all resources are extracted, mines shut down. Also, you should keep in mind, mines cannot be demolished.
[*] Seaport; Added new zone type - Seaport, and added a new UI panel to manage seaports. Seaports can only be built adjacent to the sea. You can trade any resources/products using seaports.
[*] New management panel - "Manage Workers". You can limit or shut down an industry.
[*] New management panel - "Manage Buildings". You can allow or avoid new buildings to be built over any zone type. So you can save or manage building materials. Also, It makes managing employment and population easier.
[*] Tier system is removed. It was unnecessarily complicating the management. Now all kinds of people are able to work at any workplace.
[/list]

All details are below.

Thank you for your support and playing early access!
Have fun!

notes.title: Update: v0.4.1
notes.content:
Hello,

This update is mostly about some critical bugs that occur on some platforms.
This also includes some improvements from the next update.

The most notable changes are:
[list]
[*] Roads can be demolished now. However, if people can't access the workplaces, they leave the job.
[*] Randomly given operations are smarter now to avoid recurring operations.
[*] Added macOS support experimentally.
[/list]

Actually, these features would be published along with a greater update but some critical bugs are found. So they are published early along with this update. And this update is not compatible with the previous game save but gives you an opportunity to downgrade the game if you want to keep playing your old saved state.

Now, I'm working on new content and game mechanics.
Thank you for your understanding, and support.
Have fun!

notes.title: Update: v0.4.0
notes.content:
Hello,

Here is another update that changes the feel of the game.

The most notable changes are:
[list]
[*] City improvements; Added new higher residential buildings, offices, parks and road improvements.
[*] New food product; Added farm zone type and meat product type. Farms produce meat using agrifood.
[*] New food balance; Overall food production rate is increased. Now early game is notably easier, but there are some more challanges on the mid game. Also food stock quantity unit has changed and numbers are bigger.
[*] Tier system; Now people and buildings have tiers. People gain tier according to the houses they live in. People can work at the workplaces of the same tier or below. Also people of different tiers consume different amount of foods.
[*] Resource panel improvements; Now there is a new indicator bar that shows the demand. So that you don't have to check the numbers every time to plan your next move.
[/list]

notes.title: Update: v0.3.0 - Industry
notes.content:
Hello,

This is another update that changes the feel of the game.

[b]The most notable changes are;[/b]
[list]
[*] Building demand system is removed. In early versions, buildings are formed regarding to the demand. Now player has more control over buildings. If there is enough building material for the building, it starts to be constructed immediately. Now player is more responsible which building should be built or not.
[*] Added construction stage to the buildings. Now buildings do not pop up immediately. They are constructed over time. Some buildings are fast, some are slow.
[*] Added new manufacture zone type and processed food product type. Manufacturers produce processed food using agricultural food. And processed food is consumed by people who living in apartments.
[/list]

Have fun!

notes.title: Update: v0.2.0 - Biomes
notes.content:
Hello,

Biomes update is out now!

With this update the game has changed a lot.

[b]Most notable changes are;[/b]
[list]
[*]Biomes. For now there are 4 types of biomes; plains, mid lands, high lands and water. Biomes affect industry and agricultural field production.
[*]Resources. Added wood as another building material. And removed commercial food product type to make the game simple.
[*]Added new buildings and structures.
[*]Residential houses do not require 2x2 areas anymore. They became dynamic and will fit anywhere.
[/list]
[b]Experimental changes to make the game easier;[/b]
[list]
[*]Now commercial shops do not behave like bridge between people and food as early version was. This will make the game a lot easier than before.
[*]In earlier versions, people would only work at closer jobs. Now they will work from anywhere.
[/list]

Thank you for your support and playing early access!

notes.title: What is next (v0.2.0)
notes.content:
Hello,

Now I'm developing v0.2.0 and I would like to tell the planned changes:
[list]
[*] Population / jobs balance will be changed dramatically. In early versions lack of workers was a problem, in this version unemployed people will be the problem.
[*] There will be different biomes that will be generated randomly for each game. Biomes will mostly affect agricultural fields and industry.
[*] There will be new chains on industrial production, such as goods.
[/list]

I also think about some ideas to reduce gameplay repetitiveness, like adding biomes.

Thank you for playing early access!

This update is mosty about information hint messages.
Information messages were too long and boring to read. Now all of them have been rewritten to be simple and removed unnecessary ones.

Another notable change is now nick names are shown at the leaderboard.

Thanks for playing the game!

[h3]Changelog[/h3]
[b]Notable[/b]
[list]
[*] Ui; All information messages (hints) have been simplified.
[*] Ui; Added steam nick names to the leaderboard.
[/list]
[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Ui; Changed job availability map mode.
[*] Ui; Updated structure details panel.
[*] Ui; Updated sound alerts.
[*] Ui; Minor ui improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Update - v0.1.1-beta
notes.content:
Hello,

This update mostly affects game difficulty, now it is easier to proceed. Also there are some ui improvements.

Thanks for playing the game!

[h3]Changelog[/h3]
[b]Notable[/b]
[list]
[*]Ui; Added structure details panel accessed by right click on any structure.
[*]Ui; More structure details are shown as you unlock map view modes.
[*]Game; Added demolish operation.
[*]Game; Demolish operation is unlocked by the objective "Small City".
[*]Game; It is not necessary to provide jobs for residential buildings to be constructed now.
[*]Game; Job provider buildings' range is increased.
[*]Game; Required constraints for office buildings are lowered.
[/list]
[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*]Ui; Added color fade animation to the top bar triggered by resource changes.
[*]Ui; Changed cycle control panel layout.
[*]Ui; In-game buttons' background is brighter now.
[*]Ui; Removed unnecessary informations from resource bar.
[*]Ui; Fixed a bug that undo button was disabled on the first cycle.
[*]Ui; Fixed wrong icons of cycle status messages.
[*]Ui; Fixed a bug that 3d cursor was shadowed by cycle control panel.
[*]Ui; 3d cursor is transparent now.
[*]Ui; 3d cursor is never hidden now, if it is idle grayed instead.
[*]Game; Dirty industry is less efective now.
[*]Game; Changed save game version.
[/list]
